<title>Dragon Ball (manga)</title>
<fragment>

*Dragon Ball* has become one of the most successful manga series of all time. Its initial serialization in *Weekly Shōnen Jump* was partly responsible for the magazine reaching its highest circulation of 6.53 million weekly sales. Its collected *tankōbon* volumes have over 160 million copies sold in Japan and 260 million sold worldwide,[2][a][c] making it one of the best-selling manga series. Reviewers have praised the manga for its comedy, fight scenes, and pacing, while recognizing a coming-of-age theme and its use of cultural references from Chinese mythology and Japanese folktales. Complaints from parents in the United States resulted in English-language releases being edited to remove nudity, racial stereotypes, and other content.

<fragment>

*Dragon Ball* has become one of the most successful manga series of all time. Its initial serialization in *Weekly Shōnen Jump* was partly responsible for the magazine reaching its highest circulation of 6.53 million weekly sales. Its collected *tankōbon* volumes have over 160 million copies sold in Japan and 260 million sold worldwide,[2][a][c] making it one of the best-selling manga series. Reviewers have praised the manga for its comedy, fight scenes, and pacing, while recognizing a coming-of-age theme and its use of cultural references from Chinese mythology and Japanese folktales. Complaints from parents in the United States resulted in English-language releases being edited to remove nudity, racial stereotypes, and other content.
